components.title: For the Greater Good
components.text:
If your Army Faction is T’AU EMPIRE, at the start of your Shooting phase you can select units from your army with this ability to become Observer units.
During your Shooting phase, for each Observer unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is eligible to shoot (excluding FORTIFICATION and Battle-shocked units) select one enemy unit that is visible to be marked as their Spotted unit until the end of the phase. Each enemy unit can only be marked as a Spotted unit once per phase.
Units from your army with the For the Greater Good ability (excluding Observer units) are Guided units while targeting one or more Spotted units.
Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your army in a Guided unit makes an attack that targets a Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if the Spotted unit was marked by an Observer unit that has the MARKERLIGHT keyword, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

rule.title: Killing Blow
rule.text: During the first, second and third battle rounds, ranged weapons equipped by T’AU EMPIRE models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability. During the first, second and third battle rounds, while a unit is a Guided unit, its ranged weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

enhancements.title: Coordinated Exploitation
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting their Spotted unit.

enhancements.title: Exemplar of the Mont’ka
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Killing Blow Detachment rule applies to that unit during the fourth battle round as well.

enhancements.title: Strategic Conqueror
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE model only. At the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, select one objective marker on the battlefield. While a friendly T’AU EMPIRE model is within range of that objective marker and the bearer is on the battlefield, add 1 to that friendly model’s Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.title: Strike Swiftly
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE model only. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, you can select up to two friendly T’AU EMPIRE units within 6" of this model that do not have the Scouts ability. Until the end of the battle, all models in the selected units have the Scouts 6" ability.

stratagems.title: PINPOINT COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.flavor: Mont’ka emphasises rapid evolving threat-analysis and the application of overwhelming firepower to eliminate emergent high-priority targets.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT units) from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the battle, each time a T’AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT units) from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.title: AGGRESSIVE MOBILITY
stratagems.flavor: By advancing swiftly into commanding positions, Mont’ka forces maximise the benefits of their enemies' shock and disorientation.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.title: FOCUSED FIRE
stratagems.flavor: Mont’ka doctrine heavily emphasises the massed concentration of fire upon a single target at a time, obliterating each component of the enemy force in succession with a series of unrelenting barrages.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: Two T’AU EMPIRE units from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase, and one enemy unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You cannot use this Stratagem during the fourth or fifth battle rounds.

stratagems.title: COMBAT DEBARKATION
stratagems.flavor: The most aggressive Fire caste warriors sometimes spring from moving transports, roll with the impact of landing, and come up with weapons already blazing.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: PULSE ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.flavor: Rather than charge into hand-to-hand combat, T’au soldiery instead intensify their fire patterns, pinning their advancing foes and staving off their onslaught.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit (excluding KROOT units) from your army that has just shot, and one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by one or more of those attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of your opponent’s next turn, that enemy unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2 from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.title: COUNTERFIRE DEFENCE SYSTEMS
stratagems.flavor: Point-defence systems trigger as incoming fire is detected, blasting projectiles from the air and lessening the power of the enemy fusillade.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rule.title: Bonded Heroes
rule.text: Each time a T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1. If that attack targets a unit within 8", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.

enhancements.title: Internal Grenade Racks
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only. The bearer has the GRENADES keyword, and each time the bearer ends a Normal move, you can select one enemy unit that it moved over during that move. If you do, roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.title: Prototype Weapon System
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only. Each time the bearer is selected to shoot, select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until those attacks are resolved, ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the selected ability.

enhancements.title: Puretide Engram Neurochip
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.title: Starflare Ignition System
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only. At the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.title: FAIL-SAFE DETONATOR
stratagems.flavor: Devices are incorporated into some battlesuits either to prevent high-ranking pilots being taken alive for interrogation or to prevent just such fatal explosions.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase, just after a T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model from your army is destroyed.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That destroyed model’s unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even if that unit was just destroyed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Before removing your model from play, if it has the Deadly Demise ability, do not roll for that ability; instead, you can choose whether the result of that roll is a 1 or a 6. If your model does not have the Deadly Demise ability, roll one D6 for each unit within 6" of it: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.title: STIMM INJECTORS
stratagems.flavor: On-board hypodermics shunt pain-blockers and chemical stimulants into the pilot's system.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

stratagems.title: THE SHORTENED BLADE
stratagems.flavor: Made famous by Commander Farsight and his protege Brightsword, this philosophy encourages pilots to drop into the very teeth of the enemy army and apply their firepower at point-blank range.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.title: THE ARRO’KON PROTOCOL
stratagems.flavor: Commander Arro’kon’s teachings are considered pre-eminent in the art of engaging and eliminating numerically overwhelming enemy formations.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that contains 6 or more models, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If that attack targets an enemy unit that contains 11 or more models, it has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.

stratagems.title: THE TORCHSTAR GAMBIT
stratagems.flavor: Though now disgraced by association with O'Shovah, Sub-Commander Torchstar’s strike-and-fade tactics are still taught - albeit officially under other names - in many Fire caste academies.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that can FLY whose attacks have been resolved this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. If it does, your unit cannot declare a charge this turn

stratagems.title: GRAV-INHIBITOR FIELD
stratagems.flavor: First used by O’Jir during the battle for Laguna Shard, these battlesuit-mounted emitters batter advancing foes backwards with gravitic pulse waves.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test and you must roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 6, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rule.title: Patient Hunter
rule.text: During the third, fourth and fifth battle rounds, ranged weapons equipped by T’AU EMPIRE models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. During the third, fourth and fifth battle rounds, while a unit is a Guided unit (see For the Greater Good), each time a ranged attack is made by a model in that unit that targets a Spotted unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic skill characteristics and/or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

enhancements.title: Exemplar of the Kauyon
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Patient Hunter Detachment rule applies to that unit from the second battle round onwards instead of from the third.

enhancements.title: Precision of the Patient Hunter
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. From the third battle round onwards, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.title: Solid-image Projection Unit
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three T’AU EMPIRE units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.title: Through Unity, Devastation
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting their Spotted unit.

stratagems.title: A TEMPTING TRAP
stratagems.flavor: Kauyon teaches that many things can be used to bait a trap, luring the foe into position.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. The first time you use this Stratagem, you must also select one objective marker that is not in your opponent’s deployment zone; until the end of the battle, this becomes your Trap objective marker.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Trap objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.

stratagems.title: POINT-BLANK AMBUSH
stratagems.flavor: Devastating firepower need not be applied from afar, especially when striking an unsuspecting foe.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.

stratagems.title: COORDINATE TO ENGAGE
stratagems.flavor: T’au Hunter Cadres work in close coordination to destroy the most dangerous enemy targets.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has just been selected as an Observer unit (see For the Greater Good).

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets their Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if your unit has the MARKERLIGHT keyword, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.title: COMBAT EMBARKATION
stratagems.flavor: Those who act as the lure in the Kauyon must be ready to make a hasty withdrawal once the enemy closes into killing range, lest they be trapped.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge, and one friendly TRANSPORT.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT. If it does, your opponent can select new targets for that charge.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: Every model in your T’AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit must be within 3" of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.

stratagems.title: PHOTON GRENADES
stratagems.flavor: Hurling a volley of photon grenades, the T’au leave their enemies dazzled and disorientated, unable to close the distance into combat at a crucial moment.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent's charge phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its charge target.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One T’AU EMPIRE GRENADES unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test, and until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit.

lines.label: RESTRICTION
lines.text: You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.title: WALL OF MIRRORS
stratagems.flavor: T’au Stealth Cadres utilise obfuscation fields and wide-band refraction beams to mask their advance.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One STEALTH, GHOSTKEEL or COMMANDER SHADOWSUN unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

rule.title: Hunter’s Instincts
rule.text: Each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if the target of that attack is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if the target of that attack is Below Half-strength.

enhancements.title: Borthrod Gland
enhancements.text: Kroot Flesh Shaper only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.title: Kroothawk Flock
enhancements.text: KROOT model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of the bearer.

enhancements.title: Nomadic Hunter
enhancements.text: KROOT TRAIL SHAPER model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

enhancements.title: Root-carved Weapons
enhancements.text: Kroot War Shaper model only. All weapons equipped by the bearer have the [PRECISION] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] abilities.

stratagems.title: JOIN THE HUNT
stratagems.category: Kroot Hunting Pack – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: When a Kroot Hunting Pack closes in on its prey, there are often other hunters waiting to join in the fray and take their share of any spoils.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One KROOT INFANTRY or KROOT HOUNDS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.title: A TRAP WELL LAID
stratagems.category: Kroot Hunting Pack – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The Kroot have long perfected the art of ambush hunting, their packs working in deadly concert.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One KROOT unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: After your unit has resolved its attacks this phase, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, unless the attacking unit is Battle-shocked, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.title: EMP GRENADES
stratagems.flavor: Furnished by T’au allies or returning Farstalkers, these electromagnetic grenades wreak havoc with the animuses of armoured fighting vehicles.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot or fight.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One KROOT GRENADES unit from your army within 8" of that enemy VEHICLE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, worsen the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of that enemy VEHICLE unit’s weapons by 1.

stratagems.title: THE GRISLY FEAST
stratagems.category: Kroot Hunting Pack – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The psychological impact of witnessing one's comrades being dismembered and devoured by gore-splattered Kroot cannot be overstated.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One KROOT unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: In your opponent’s next Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the unit taking that test is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.title: GUERRILLA WARRIORS
stratagems.category: Kroot Hunting Pack – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Kroot see no value in stand-up fights, caring little for honour or glory. They hit and fade, frustrating their foes and bleeding them by degrees until - weakened and out of position - they are rendered vulnerable.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase, just after a KROOT unit from your army Falls Back.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That KROOT unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.

stratagems.title: HIDDEN HUNTERS
stratagems.category: Kroot Hunting Pack – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The Kroot are experts in camouflage and concealment, able to utilise cover in ways most foes would never consider and - to their great misfortune - do not anticipate.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One KROOT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

rule.title: Integrated Command Structure
rule.text:
Friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS units have the following ability:
Harnessed Alien Instincts: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is prey-marked:
- While a unit is prey-marked, that unit has +3" detection range
Friendly GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT/STEALTH BATTLESUITS units have the following ability:
Localised Stealth Projectors (Aura): When a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit within 6" of this unit has shot, those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.This detachment has the AUXILIARIES tag and cannot be taken with another AUXILIARIES detachment.

enhancements.title: Student of Kauyon
enhancements.text: KROOT SHAPER model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to three friendly KROOT CARNIVORES/FARSTALKERS units. Those units have Deep Strike.

enhancements.title: Admired Leader
enhancements.text: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT models). In your Command phase, you can select one KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit within 12" of this model. If you do, that unit has +1 Ld and OC until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.title: EXPERIMENTAL MODIFICATIONS
stratagems.flavor:
These experimental Earth caste weapon upgrades can only activate
for short bursts at a time, but the extra stopping power they
provide is formidable.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit is selected to attack.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s attacks have +1 AP.

stratagems.title: ALIEN EXPERTISE
stratagems.flavor:
There is much that the alien auxiliaries of the T’au empire can
teach the Fire caste, not least through practical and deadly
battlefield demonstrations.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit is selected to make an advance move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.title: GUIDED FIRE
stratagems.flavor:
Firing on coordinates provided by selfless alien auxiliaries,
the T’au are able to scythe down their targets with
pinpoint precision.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly T’AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS units) is selected to shoot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That T’AU EMPIRE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" of a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit have [LETHAL HITS].

rule.title: Superior Craftsmanship
rule.text:
Friendly BATTLESUIT CHARACTER units’ ranged attacks have +6" R.
This detachment has the BATTLESUIT tag and cannot be taken with another BATTLESUIT detachment.

enhancements.title: Thermoneutronic Projector
enhancements.text: BATTLESUIT model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model’s T’au Flamer weapons. That weapon’s attacks have:

enhancements.title: Plasma Accelerator Rifle
enhancements.text: BATTLESUIT model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model’s Plasma Rifle weapons. That weapon’s attacks have:

enhancements.title: Supernova Launcher
enhancements.text: BATTLESUIT model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of this model’s Airbursting Fragmentation Projector weapons. That weapon’s attacks have:

stratagems.title: EXPERIMENTAL AMMUNITION
stratagems.flavor: From hardened warheads and amplified ion capacitors, to hyperaccelerated pulse fields and refined fusion cores, the T’au are forever innovating improvements to improve the lethality of their ammunition.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BATTLESUIT CHARACTER unit is selected to shoot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That BATTLESUIT CHARACTER unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: - +1 S. - OR: +1 S, AP and [HAZARDOUS].

rule.title: Expert Fieldcraft
rule.text: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit is selected to shoot, those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

enhancements.title: Negation Emitters
enhancements.text: STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

enhancements.title: Unmasking Suite
enhancements.text: GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT/PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only. When this unit is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +9" detection range until this unit has shot.

stratagems.title: MARKER BEACON
stratagems.flavor: These small devices emit tightbeam triangulation signals for follow‑up waves of incoming T’au forces, silently marking out strategically vital sites to be secured.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.title: MICRODRONE SUPPORT
stratagems.flavor: Deployed from overflights of heavier stealth‑capable carrier drones, these tiny machines provide versatile battlefield support for T’au stealth specialists, even in the midst of vicious firefights.

lines.label: WHEN

errata.title: Do a unit's abilities continue to function while they are embarked within a TRANSPORT?
errata.text:
Yes, within the restrictions specified by the ability itself. Embarked units are Not On The Battlefield (01.02.04), so any ability requiring visibility or measurement to another unit will fail.
Example: Azrael is attached to an Intercessor Squad unit and embarked within a TRANSPORT, and that TRANSPORT is making a shooting attack using the Firing Deck ability. While Azrael’s Supreme Grand Master ability is still technically active, it will have no effect, as the requirements of the ability are not met (the ability affects ‘weapons equipped by models’ in Azrael’s unit, and for the purposes of Firing Deck, the TRANSPORT itself is equipped with those weapons instead).

errata.title: If a rule says a unit can embark into a TRANSPORT in a turn that unit disembarked, does this ignore the core rules restriction on embarking in a turn that unit made a set up move (see 18.02)?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: Are models that are within the boundary of a terrain area, but not on the ground floor of a terrain area (e.g. overhanging parts of FRAME VEHICLES or models on terrain features that are within that terrain area) within that terrain area?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: When my unit shoots at another unit, how does it work if some models in the target unit are fully visible to some models in my unit, while others are within a terrain area/not fully visible?
errata.text:
For each attacking model in your unit, determine whether the target unit has the benefit of cover, as described in Terrain and Visibility. In this scenario, the target unit will likely have the benefit of cover against some of the attacking models, but not all.
This means that, in an example unit where all attacking models are using the same weapon, when you get to the Resolve Attacks step of the Attack Sequence, you will collect dice for attacks made by models against which the target unit has the benefit of cover separately from the dice for attacks made by models against which the target unit does not have the benefit of cover.

errata.title: My attack has a rule that means it results in a critical hit on a hit roll of 4+. Does this work when snap shooting?
errata.text: Unless otherwise stated, no: when snap shooting, each attack only hits on a roll of 6.

errata.title: My attack has a rule that means it results in a critical hit on a hit roll of 4+, and I would otherwise need a 5+ to hit. Does a 4+ hit?
errata.text: Yes, except when snap shooting: when snap shooting, each attack only hits on a roll of 6.

errata.title: If a unit has a rule that allows it to start an action when it is battle-shocked can it also continue doing that action if it becomes battle-shocked after starting an action?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: If a unit becomes battle-shocked after starting an action does it stop performing that action?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: Does my model or unit become engaged while moving through a enemy units engagement range during a move?
errata.text: No

errata.title: I have a rule that triggers when a mortal wound is allocated to a model, when does this happen?
errata.text: When you select a model in the Select Model step of Mortal Wounds (06.02).

errata.title: I failed hazard rolls from [Hazardous] weapons, do those mortal wounds have to be allocated to the models with the [HAZARDOUS] weapons?
errata.text: No, you allocate the mortal wounds to the unit as per Mortal Wounds (06.02). (This represents Bob the guardsmen picking up his fallen squad mates plasma gun or that the twisting power of James the Chaos Sorcerer pulling his followers into the warp.)

errata.title: If a rule says my unit must make a hazard roll does every model in the unit make a hazard roll?
errata.text: No, the unit would make 1 single hazard roll.

errata.title: If a unit makes any disembark move in a turn (i.e. Disembark move, Emergency Disembark move etc.) has it disembarked that turn?
errata.text: Yes.

errata.title: When declaring the allocation order of groups in my unit I have more than one non-CHARACTER groups that contain a model with a missing wound, how must I select the order?
errata.text: Those groups can be selected in an order of your choosing but must be in an order that makes them come before any non-CHARACTER groups that do not contain a model with a missing wound.

errata.title: I have a unit being attacked with weapons that will modify some of their save rolls to be worse then 6 should I make those save rolls?
errata.text: Yes, because other models in your unit may have Sv’s that are better those models you’ve mentioned, this means that enough save rolls could be allocated to the those models that the rest of the results are not greater then the Sv’s of the other models in your unit.

errata.title: Can I group or allocate a wound to a destroyed model?
errata.text: No.

errata.title: If my unit has taken control of an objective at the end of my movement phase and that unit has as an ability that secures an objective they control, can they secure that objective?
errata.text: Yes
